publishDecision: These 21 saved Gemini results contain usable cooking steps. Their required source ingredients have recipe-local owned-item mappings, and the full V3 dataset passes the backend DatasetLoader validator. Unspecified quantities remain null rather than being invented.

draftReasons.W12Fpy5iEo0: Lime and stevia are required in the saved source recipe. Mapping them away to common pantry items would change the recipe, while adding both as owned requirements needs a user-centered catalog decision. Keep the source and steps, with these required mappings unresolved.
draftReasons.aV7zcAPmuPA: The saved recipe requires both udon noodles and the liquid soup base from a packaged udon product. Udon soup base has no resolved owned item, and this special packaged requirement needs review under the solo-cooking catalog policy.
draftReasons.rMpXv_38KRM: The saved source requires 깻가루, which does not establish whether this means ground sesame or perilla seed powder. Do not guess an owned item from the ambiguous expression.

excludedReasons.gHrayv9DmMQ: Requires 돼지다짐육, which the user previously removed together with recipes depending on minced pork.
excludedReasons.WfCFYyQYj5U: Only oil, kimchi, and rice are required; tuna or spam and seaweed flakes are optional. This repeats the previously rejected kimchi-and-rice-only recipe pattern.
excludedReasons.jypVMrPn50I: The saved ingredient quantities and cooking steps are effectively the same as existing PUBLISHED recipe ze4eeuPaVfQ (새마을식당 7분 김치찌개), so another copy would clutter the catalog.

sourceMetadata: YouTube metadata was queried separately without calling Gemini. Across today's 49 new recipes, title and channel snapshots were saved for 43; six public oEmbed lookups returned no metadata and remain null.
titlePolicy: Recipe names use short Korean dish names without English or promotional qualifiers. Saved Gemini ingredient expressions and steps remain source-faithful; a separately fetched YouTube sourceTitle is preserved when available.
validator: Backend DatasetLoader passed for the full V3 dataset after this batch and metadata backfill; DatasetLoaderV3Test and git diff --check passed.
